description: A tall standing letter P in perspective, its bowl at the top right, set over a flattened S-shape lying on the ground and sweeping to the left beneath it.
A circle cut into four unequal pieces by a vertical gap left of centre and a horizontal gap below centre, the large upper-right piece dominant and smaller pieces in the other quarters.
Two tall parallel rounded bars standing side by side, each with a rounded top and a bottom end cut to a point angled inward toward the other bar.
A large ring at the upper right with a dot centre, linked by a long straight rod down to a small ring left of centre, which a short arm joins to another small ring at the far left.
A sphere divided by an X-shaped cut into a curved top wedge, two side crescents and a large rounded bottom segment, the two X strokes curving as they cross.
A tall conical wizard hat standing on a wide flat brim, its tip bending over to the right in a hooked kink, with a horizontal band line across its lower half.
A caped figure from the front: a tall rounded helmet with a face opening showing a mask, above a wide cape collar curving across the shoulders with small round clasps; the reference is hard to read.
A round bomb with a short angled cap at its upper right, a fuse extending from the cap, and a small ring spark with a short dash at the fuse tip.
A puffy cloud with rounded bumps resting on two short vertical posts that stand on a long flat rectangular base, like a cloud-topped platform or tree.
A flower from the front: a round head with a wide inner oval ring and two upright eye marks at its centre, a short stem and two pointed leaves spreading out at the base.
